body: Dallas Mavericks have signed Walter Clayton Jr. to a two-way contract, with reports indicating he was waived by the Memphis Grizzlies before the deal. The team also signed another former first-rounder after waiving Dwight Powell.

findings.evidence_quote: Walter Clayton Jr. Signs Two-Way NBA Deal With Mavericks
Mavericks Emerge As Potential Suitor For Walter Clayton Jr. After Grizzlies Waive Him
